'''Charred Island''' is located south of the [[Void Knights' Outpost]] and [[Pest Control Island]], in the [[Unquiet Ocean]]. Docking here requires level 60 [[Sailing]], unboosted.

A [[Dark hole (Charred Island)|dark hole]] in the north-west of the island leads to the [[Charred Dungeon]], in which [[lava strykewyrm]]s and [[rubium rocks]] can be found. A [[rope]] is required to be used on the hole to access the dungeon the first time, and one can be found on the southern part of the island near the bank chest space. The dungeon contains the [[old chest]], which can be unlocked using the [[charred key]] to obtain [[Zamorakian paint]].

==Transportation==
The island can only be reached using Sailing. Mooring at the island requires level 60 Sailing.

The fastest way to get to the island without using [[Teleport to Boat]] is to sail south-west from the [[Red Rock]] (requires partial completion of [[The Red Reef]] quest to access). At Red Rock, player can either pay the [[Shipwright]] to recover their boat, or cast [[summon boat]] spell. Without access to Red Rock, [[Void Knights' Outpost]] is the closest port to sail from.

==Features==
* [[Anvil space]]
* [[Bank chest space]]
* A [[sea charting|chartable]] set of [[dragon scales]]
* 6 [[young tree]]s for hunting [[Red salamander (Hunter)|red salamanders]]
* 11 [[coal rocks]]
* 7 [[Rock Crab]]s
* Closest [[anvil]] to a [[bank]] if you have not completed [[Song of the Elves]] at just 9 tiles, beating out the previous 10 tiles from [[Varrock west bank]]
* 10 pieces of [[seaweed]] spawn along the eastern and southern coastline, respawning every 60 seconds
* [[Rope]] spawn on top of crate west of bank chest

A [[Small key (Charred Island)|small key]] can also be found by digging in the northern part of the island, three tiles west of the westernmost dead tree. This is used to unlock a chest on [[Brittle Isle]] to find the [[rosewood & cotton sails schematic]].
